mysharedbrain.description: Plain HTTP on the LAN: the `mysharedbrain-plain` Traefik route (homeserver), node IP:8082, no TLS and no hostname, LAN-allowlisted. pi's MCP client is undici fetch, which has no caFile option, so trusting the private CA previously depended on NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS being set in every launch path. Plain HTTP removes the certificate from the picture rather than depending on that env var.

kb.description: kb kanban MCP over plain HTTP on the LAN: the `kb-plain` Traefik route (homeserver), node IP:8083, no TLS and no hostname, LAN-allowlisted. Same reasoning as mysharedbrain: pi MCPs over undici fetch with no caFile option, so plain HTTP avoids depending on NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS. Stateless POST /mcp on the `kb web` process -- no sessions, board is whatever kb web serves.
